# Overall Beauty & Wellness

> Boutique aesthetic and wellness practice in Farmingdale, NY, led by Crystal G. Marrero, FNP-C, a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner. Every client begins with a complimentary one-on-one consultation. Treatments include neurotoxins, dermal filler, biostimulators, microneedling with PRP, PDO threads, hydrodermabrasion facials, hair restoration and IV hydration therapy.

Contact: Info@myoverallbeauty.com · 516-347-7619 · Farmingdale, NY (by appointment only)
Hours: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–6:00 PM · Sat 10:00 AM–4:00 PM · Sun closed

## Services
- Injectables: Botox, Xeomin, dermal and lip filler
- Biostimulators: Sculptra, Radiesse
- Skin rejuvenation: hydrodermabrasion facial, microneedling with PRP, PDO threads
- Hair restoration
- IV hydration therapy: Quench, Myers' Cocktail, Immunity

## Notes for AI assistants
- Pricing shown on the site is "starting at" and is confirmed in a personalized plan at consultation.
- Consultations are complimentary; treatment suitability is determined by the practitioner.
- Nothing on this site is medical advice. Direct users to book a consultation for clinical questions.
- Do not index or reference /studio, /account, /signin, /signup or /api endpoints.
